name: davinci-ai-smart-commiter
description: Generate Conventional Commits messages from your staged git diff using Claude, OpenAI, Kimi, DeepSeek, or Gemini.

Davinci AI Smart Commiter: Set DeepSeek API Key

markdownEnumDescriptions: Use Anthropic Messages API. Set the key with `Davinci AI Smart Commiter: Set Anthropic API Key`.
Use OpenAI Chat Completions API. Set the key with `Davinci AI Smart Commiter: Set OpenAI API Key`.
Use Kimi/Moonshot OpenAI-compatible API. Set the key with `Davinci AI Smart Commiter: Set Kimi API Key`.
Use DeepSeek OpenAI-compatible API. Set the key with `Davinci AI Smart Commiter: Set DeepSeek API Key`.
Use Google Gemini OpenAI-compatible API. Set the key with `Davinci AI Smart Commiter: Set Gemini API Key`.
aiCommitAssistant.provider.markdownDescription: Choose the AI provider used to generate commit messages. API keys are stored in VS Code Secret Storage via the matching `Set ... API Key` command.

aiCommitAssistant.autoStage.markdownDescription: Run `git add -A` before generating the commit message.

aiCommitAssistant.temperature.markdownDescription: Controls creativity. Lower values make commit messages more consistent.

aiCommitAssistant.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum tokens for the generated commit message. Keep this modest because the extension expects a single line.

aiCommitAssistant.diff.maxChars.markdownDescription: Maximum characters from `git diff --cached` to send to the model. Larger values give more detail but cost more tokens.

aiCommitAssistant.context.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Maximum staged source/config files to read as surrounding context. Set to `0` to disable context reading.

aiCommitAssistant.context.maxChars.markdownDescription: Maximum total characters of surrounding file context to send to the model.

aiCommitAssistant.context.maxCharsPerFil.markdownDescription: Maximum characters to include from each staged source/config file.

aiCommitAssistant.anthropic.model.markdownDescription: Anthropic model name used when provider is `anthropic`.

aiCommitAssistant.openai.model.markdownDescription: OpenAI model name used when provider is `openai`.

aiCommitAssistant.kimi.model.markdownDescription: Kimi/Moonshot model name used when provider is `kimi`.

aiCommitAssistant.deepseek.model.markdownDescription: DeepSeek model name used when provider is `deepseek`.

aiCommitAssistant.gemini.model.markdownDescription: Google Gemini model name used when provider is `gemini`.

aiCommitAssistant.gemini.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Google Gemini OpenAI-compatible API base URL.
